item.title: 【UPSCALED】Eminem - Sing For The Moment (ALAC - Upscale 1080p) (updated 2026)
item.description:
524 shots later, I can say this was one of the exhausting ones. The quality of each shot in this vídeo varies WILDLY, so I used different AI settings on each one (ok, I used 2 or 3 different settings and alternated between them). I tried to make everything sharper, but some shots are just made to be messed up. As with the older version of the upscale, it's a huge file because it's deinterlaced back to the original 59.94 fps (highest frame rate in the video, but there are some shots which are 23.976p). Also I had to re-do all the grain shot by shot (using both the VOB and MHD versions for comparison), because Topaz had removed everything (and it would be pointless to re-do the grain just for it to get loss during compression). Hope y'all like it

P.S.: I tried to include as many screenshots as possible, so you can see the varying quality.
